name: shiro-screen-share
description: Shiro Screen Share — Desktop app with isolated process audio capture and WebRTC P2P multi-stream
author: Hito

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['dist/main', 'dist/preload', 'dist/renderer'].forEach(d => { try { if (fs.existsSync(d)) fs.rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true, maxRetries: 3 }); } catch(e){} });"
scripts.build:renderer: esbuild src/renderer/src/app.ts --bundle --platform=browser --target=chrome120 --outfile=dist/renderer/app.bundle.js --external:electron --format=iife --tree-shaking=true && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.copyFileSync('src/renderer/index.html', 'dist/renderer/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('src/renderer/index.css', 'dist/renderer/index.css'); fs.copyFileSync('icon.ico', 'dist/renderer/icon.ico');"
scripts.build:all: npm run clean && tsc --noEmit && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run build:renderer
